description: Operator-valued A^λ_{μν}(I) extraction via bilinear-system inversion. Confirms refined Sub-lemma 2.1: the (μ,ν)-block of ρ_λ(I) is generally a non-scalar operator on V_μ ⊗ V_ν. For the deuteron interface I = σ_2 - h(1/2 - δ/4) on H_6 ↓ H_3 × H_3 — the canonical COLOUR-WEIGHTED p-n crossing, ctype `averaged_weighted` — all 11 λ admit consistent operator-valued A^λ_{μν} solutions to machine precision; only the 1-dim extreme λ ∈ {(6), (1^6)} have scalar A^λ_{μν}. The extracted matrices are the concrete categorical inputs the Hoefsmit-formula derivation must reproduce per docs/audits/2026-05-04-sublemma-2-1-categorical-proof.md.

parameters.interface: I = σ_2 - h(1/2 - δ/4)  [ctype `averaged_weighted`: the canonical colour-weighted p-n crossing]

precision.accuracy_ceiling_cause: char_fast._compiled_sigmas returns rep matrices built by _cached_seminormal(shape), which are float64 with q already substituted; the mpmath backend widens them but adds no information. Arithmetic here is exact-to-precision; the INPUT data is float64. Digits past ~16 are arithmetic, not mathematics.
